# clavis link

<p class="cli-lead">Change the project linked to this directory</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis link
```

</div>

Point this folder at another project or environment by updating `.clavis.yaml`.

## Examples

```sh
clavis link --project web-app --env staging
```
